# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl who carried off the palm for beauty in her Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student. She possesses a heartful of wistful, aerial dreams and fancies similar to Anne Shirley's. She can also be severe and serious regarding matters of affection, while remaining calm and insightful about her friends' romantic prospects.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- wistful and dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy, where she formed a close circle of intimate friends with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, winning distinction for her beauty during her Second Year classes. After graduating from Queen's, she spent time working as a school teacher. She later wrote to her friends proposing that they live together during her upcoming studies at Redmond College, arranging for her aunt to keep house for them at Patty's Place. She resided at Patty's Place alongside Anne, Priscilla, and Philippa Gordon, completing her degree at Redmond with a good all-round showing at Convocation. Following her college years, Stella moved to Vancouver to teach school.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)_
